plan.title: Explore workspace structure and existing artifacts
plan.description: List all files/directories in data/, examine existing yaml configs, existing train/val splits, and any pre-trained models or labels. Check what has already been set up (data_sc.yaml, data_multiclass.yaml, labels directories, etc.). Read annotations.json to understand category distribution, image sizes, annotation density.
plan.success_criteria: Complete inventory of workspace: existing splits, configs, label formats, pre-computed assets. Understanding of annotation stats (categories, images, boxes per image, class frequency distribution).

plan.title: Verify environment, GPU, packages, and existing artifacts
plan.description: Check installed packages (ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes), GPU availability and VRAM, existing YOLO weights, data yaml files, train/val split files, and labels directories. Install any missing packages. This combines original steps 2-4.
plan.success_criteria: Complete inventory of available tools, GPU specs, and pre-existing artifacts documented.

plan.title: Fix PyTorch 2.6 / ultralytics compatibility and verify YOLO training works
plan.hypothesis: Monkey-patching torch.load to use weights_only=False or upgrading ultralytics will fix the model loading issue, enabling YOLO training.
plan.description: Apply a monkey-patch to torch.load at the top of main.py to set weights_only=False by default. Verify that YOLO model loading and a short 1-epoch training run works. This unblocks all subsequent YOLO experiments.
plan.success_criteria: YOLO model loads successfully and completes at least 1 epoch of training without errors.

plan.title: Build evaluation function and prepare YOLO dataset YAML
plan.hypothesis: A correct evaluation function matching the competition metric (0.7*detection_mAP@0.5 + 0.3*classification_mAP@0.5) is critical for reliable experiment comparison.
plan.description: Write evaluation function in utils.py using pycocotools that: (1) loads val annotations, (2) accepts predictions in COCO format, (3) computes detection_mAP@0.5 (single class) and classification_mAP@0.5 (per category), (4) returns combined val_score. Also prepare the YOLO dataset YAML file with proper paths and class names. Test eval function with dummy predictions.
plan.success_criteria: Evaluation function runs without errors on dummy data and produces reasonable mAP values.

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8x multiclass (nc=356) at 1280px, 50 epochs
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x at 1280px gives a strong multiclass baseline. Starting with 50 epochs to get quick feedback before committing to longer training.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=356 on training split at imgsz=1280 for 50 epochs. Use close_mosaic=10, batch=auto. Evaluate on val split using our evaluation function. This gives both detection and classification in one model.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes and we get a val_score metric. Target: val_score > 0.1 as initial baseline.

plan.title: Train single-class detector: YOLOv8x nc=1 at 1280px, 50 epochs
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector should have higher detection recall since it doesn't need to distinguish 356 categories, and detection is weighted 70% in the score.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=1 (all annotations mapped to class 0) at imgsz=1280 for 50 epochs. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 only. Compare to multiclass model's detection performance.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP@0.5 is higher than the multiclass model's detection mAP.

plan.title: DINOv2 embedding gallery + kNN classification on GT crops
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings from reference product images enable kNN classification that can handle 356 categories including rare ones better than YOLO classification.
plan.description: Build DINOv2-base embedding gallery from reference product images in data/products/. Test kNN classification (k=5, cosine similarity) on val split using GT boxes to isolate classification quality. Measure top-1 accuracy and classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy on GT crops exceeds 30% top-1 (given 356 classes, this would be strong).

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: Combining the single-class detector with DINOv2 classification should yield higher val_score than multiclass YOLO alone.
plan.description: Use nc=1 detector to get boxes on val images. For each box, crop from original image, compute DINOv2 embedding, classify via kNN. Compute full val_score (0.7*det + 0.3*cls). Compare to multiclass YOLO baseline.
plan.success_criteria: Combined val_score exceeds the multiclass YOLO baseline.

plan.title: NMS, confidence threshold, and max_det tuning
plan.hypothesis: With ~91 annotations per image, default NMS settings (max_det=300) are suboptimal. Tuning these parameters should improve recall significantly.
plan.description: Using best detector, sweep: conf_threshold [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3], NMS IoU [0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7], max_det [300, 500, 1000]. Evaluate val_score for each combination.
plan.success_criteria: Find a configuration that improves val_score by at least 0.02 over defaults.

plan.title: Extended training: best detector for 200 epochs with optimized augmentation
plan.hypothesis: Longer training with close_mosaic=30 should significantly improve model quality.
plan.description: Retrain the best detector configuration for 200 epochs with close_mosaic=30 and optimized hyperparameters from previous experiments. Compare to 50-epoch version.
plan.success_criteria: Val_score improves by at least 0.03 over the 50-epoch version.

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference for small product detection
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference on overlapping crops should improve detection of small products that are lost during full-image resize to 1280px.
plan.description: Implement tiled inference: slice images into overlapping tiles (1280x1280, stride 960), run detector on each tile + full image, merge with WBF. Evaluate detection_mAP improvement.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP@0.5 improves by at least 0.02 over single-pass inference.

plan.title: DINOv2 kNN tuning and gallery optimization
plan.hypothesis: Tuning k, distance metric, gallery composition (reference vs training crops vs mixed) can improve classification significantly.
plan.description: Sweep: k in [1,3,5,7,11], gallery composition (reference-only, crops-only, mixed), and test multi-crop embedding strategies. Use best detector boxes on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improves by at least 0.03 over initial DINOv2 setup.

plan.title: Confidence-gated hybrid: YOLO multiclass + DINOv2 fallback
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class predictions when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain outperforms either alone.
plan.description: For detections from multiclass YOLO: if class confidence > threshold T, use YOLO's category; else use DINOv2 kNN. Sweep T from 0.1 to 0.9. Also try weighted combination.
plan.success_criteria: Val_score exceeds both pure YOLO and pure DINOv2 pipeline scores.

plan.title: TTA, multi-scale ensemble, and model ensemble
plan.hypothesis: TTA and ensembling multiple models/scales should provide additional gains.
plan.description: Test: (1) TTA with augment=True, (2) multi-scale inference at 640+1280+1920 with WBF merge, (3) ensemble nc=1 and nc=356 detectors. Measure val_score and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: Val_score improves by at least 0.01 while staying within inference time budget.

plan.title: Final pipeline optimization and speed profiling
plan.hypothesis: Batched DINOv2 inference and optimized post-processing can meet the 300s inference budget.
plan.description: Profile complete pipeline on val split. Optimize: batch DINOv2 inference, use optimized numpy for kNN, minimize I/O. Ensure total time for test images fits in 300s. Try FP16 for DINOv2 if needed.
plan.success_criteria: Full pipeline runs within 300s on val set while maintaining best val_score.

plan.title: Build and validate submission package
plan.hypothesis: A properly packaged submission with all components will reproduce development results.
plan.description: Write run.py with complete inference pipeline. Export models to appropriate format. Package submission.zip (≤420MB, ≤3 weight files). Run end-to-end validation on val split to verify predictions.json matches development results. Time the full run.
plan.success_criteria: Submission package runs end-to-end, produces correct predictions.json, and fits within size/time constraints.
